snippet.title: Mahoutsukai ni naru houhou / 魔法使いになる方法 [Saturn] [Gameplay]
snippet.description:
This is an interesting game that I've been working my way through.  Normally, I think you can work out what to do in a lot of Japanese games even if you don't speak the language, but I think this one would be quite difficult unless you can figure out key parts of the dialogue and take notes.  If you're learning Japanese though, it's a fairly easy game to understand, I think, maybe somewhere around N4 or N3 level.  The one problem I have with it is the style of the kanji can sometimes make the characters difficult to read.

In the first part of the game, we need to gather the ingredients for a spell to make.. well, raisins.  So to do that, you need to get one ingredient from an area to the west of the starting house, and one ingredient from the area southwest of the starting house.

A couple screens south and then one or two to the west, there's an area with a house and a girl standing outside on top of some flowers.  Have a conversation with her, and when she leaves, search the flowers for the first item.

To the west of the house is a bridge with a mole man guarding it.  He won't move unless you give him some ミミズ, which you can find in a pond surrounded by vines to the south (the area is called 東のイバラの森).  There will be a question mark instead of the usual exclamation mark.  Head back to the mole man and give him some, and he'll move and let you pass.  Keep heading west into the cave, deal with another mole man, and then within the cave, to the south of the entrance, you'll find the second ingredient in one of the spots there.

Head back to your house (or use the spell to do so from the menu) and you can make the spell in the lab.  You'll want to go talk to the old man first and spend a few days studying the spell (干しビドウ創造) to get to 100%.
